A '''hydrovalve''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]] component. It regulated the power flow to the [[Engine coupling/Legends|engine couplings]]. Faulty hydrovalves could reduce the flow to the couplings which decreased a ship's sublight speed.<ref name="RPG1" />

While fixing his ship, the ''[[Dorion Discus]]'', after a [[Space warfare/Legends|battle]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] found a faulty hydrovalve. By fixing the hydrovalve, Garnet increased the sublight speed of his vessel.<ref name="RPG1" />
